def next_field(line, start):
    if start >= len(line):  # If we're at the end of the line, return an empty field and -1 as next_start
        return '', -1

    if line[start] != '"':  # Field is not quote enclosed, split on comma
        end = line.find(',', start)
        if end == -1:
            end = len(line)
        field = line[start:end]
        next_start = end + 1
    else:  # Field is quote enclosed, process quoted content
        end = start + 1
        while end < len(line) and line[end] != '"':
            if line[end] == '\\':  # Handle escaped quotes
                end += 1
            end += 1
        if end == len(line) or line[end] != '"':  # Unterminated quote
            raise ValueError("Unterminated quoted field")
        field = line[start+1:end].replace('""', '"')  # Replace double quotes with single
        next_start = end + 2  # Move past the closing quote and any following comma

    return field, next_start
